neighbours.label: General statements about what people inwardly need or want: 'to feel that …', 'something they love', what affects 'us' — generic human-needs prose (weak, low-magnitude pole)
fire: Every child needs to feel that someone at home is proud of them.
Most of us hope our daily work can be something we truly love.
Employees want to feel that their ideas are heard by those in charge.
Deep down, people wish their life to be something that matters to others.
A volunteer needs to feel that the hours they give make a difference.
Habit can cause us to ignore the quiet joys that surround us.
Teenagers long to feel that they belong to a group that accepts them.
Everyone hopes their home will be something they are glad to return to.
quiet: Every tyre needs to be checked before the car leaves the depot.
Most of the bolts on the frame are made of stainless steel.
Engineers want the valve to be closed before the pump starts.
By law, the label has to list the weight and the country of origin.
A boiler needs to be drained once the pressure drops below the mark.
Frost can cause the pipes to crack along the north wall.
Salmon swim upstream to reach the gravel beds where they hatched.
The ferry will leave the harbour at noon and return at four.

notes: Card: no single token, max only 7.7; examples 'to⟦ feel⟧ that their managers support them', 'job to be⟦ something⟧ they love', 'cause⟦ us⟧', 'surrounds⟦ us⟧'. Probes: 'job to be something they love' 0.74, 'want to feel that our work matters' 0.60, 'needs to feel that' 0.47, 'cause us to miss' 0.39; 'engine needs to be oiled' 0.11, 'cause the river to flood' 0.01, timetable sentences 0.03-0.05.
